changeSet.author: uzinfocom
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_id, permission_id, version, created_at, updated_at) SELECT r.id, p.id, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM role r, permission p WHERE r.name IN ('isemid_epidemiologist', 'isemid_assistant_epidemiologist', 'isemid_epidim_head', 'isemid_general_practitioner') AND p.subject = 'SPEECH_TO_TEXT' ON CONFLICT (role_id, permission_id) DO NOTHING;
INSERT INTO role_permission_actions (role_permission_id, action_id) SELECT rp.id, a.id FROM role_permissions rp JOIN role r ON r.id = rp.role_id JOIN permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id JOIN action a ON a.code = 'CREATE' WHERE r.name IN ('isemid_epidemiologist', 'isemid_assistant_epidemiologist', 'isemid_epidim_head', 'isemid_general_practitioner') AND p.subject = 'SPEECH_TO_TEXT' ON CONFLICT (role_permission_id, action_id) DO NOTHING;
